summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FASE G-6 (Transaksi Antar Entitas). Backend: 13/14 tests passed. Frontend: All UI components and flows working correctly. Detail Panel displays journals, eliminations, warehouse tasks, and timeline. Konsolidasi Grup sync-g6 button working with proper notifications.

minor_bugs.issue: Does not enforce authentication - returns 200 instead of 401/403 when called without auth token
minor_bugs.impact: Security issue - endpoint should require accounting.manage permission

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/interco/transactions/{id}/journal for received transaction - returns seller, buyer, cogs, receipt journals with balanced entries
Backend: GET /api/interco/transactions/{id}/journal for draft transaction - returns seller=null, buyer=null (not error)
Backend: POST /api/consolidation/sync-g6 is idempotent (second call created=0)
Backend: POST /api/interco/transactions/{id}/warehouse-task on draft returns 400 with confirmation message
Backend: POST /api/supplier-contracts with contract_type='internal' creates partner_kind='entity'
Backend: All regression endpoints return 200 (summary, transactions, accounts, settlements, meta, contracts)
UI: Login and navigation to Antar Entitas page works
UI: All 4 KPI cards present (Total Piutang, Total Utang, Dokumen Terbuka, Pasangan PT Aktif)
UI: All 3 tabs present (Daftar Transaksi, Saldo Antar-PT, Settlement)
UI: All 3 action buttons present (Kontrak Internal, Buat Settlement, Transaksi Baru)
UI: Transactions table displays 6 rows with Physical Goods column
UI: Detail Panel opens and displays seller/buyer columns
UI: Detail Panel shows proper empty messages for draft transactions
UI: Detail Panel displays warehouse tasks, eliminations, and timeline sections
UI: Konsolidasi Grup - Eliminasi tab displays sync-g6 and sync-pairs buttons
UI: Sync-g6 button works and displays notification with sync results
UI: G-6 count badge shows '2 otomatis dari transaksi antar-PT'
UI: 2 AUTO G-6 badges displayed on elimination entries
UI: All labels in Bahasa Indonesia (no English technical terms visible)
